purpose: Exact inventory and full-spec target contract for every Expo route and Hub modal exposed to users.
laws: every discovered Expo route and rendered lazy Hub modal has exactly one entry
source content, interaction counts, backend mappings, navigation targets and accessibility signals are exact-head bound
every surface declares loading, empty, error, retry, success and unavailable semantics
static surface qualification never implies observed runtime readiness
adding, deleting or changing an exposed surface requires refreshing and reviewing this registry
